summary: Sandbags and improvised plate on rebel vehicles, painted team marks, dusty rubber tyres, dark armoured glass, open tilts and canvas flaps, soft rotor shimmer, see-through van, tractor and Blackfoot cabs, ensigns and biminis on boats, and louvres, exhausts and hatches that read right.
rationale: Fabric, finish, glass and fitting changes across every family: one matched studio sheet shows a representative of each, framed close where the change is small.
